answer_1.quote: Our task is to generate text given a context and a source of content (document). Additionally, the generated text should coherently fit the context and contain information from the document...
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses and Wikipedia article updates

answer_2.quote: we evaluate our system-generated sentences against the reference sentences on Rouge-L , BLEU and METEOR metrics...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation was conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk. We conduct 3 comparative studies between the BART, CoDR and DoHA outputs... annotators were provided with the reference sentence and the generated outputs of two systems labeled A and B... They were instructed to "Pick the option which is closest in meaning with the reference option." Relevance: ... They were instructed to "Pick the option which contains information from the document and fits the dialogue context coherently". Fluency: ... evaluated on a scale of 1 (unreadable) to 4 (perfect)...
answer_4.guideline: Pick the option closest in meaning to the reference; pick the option that contains information from the document and fits the context; rate fluency on a 1‑4 scale.
